oil.when: 2006 with the CUSTOMIZE button and INFO dial
steps: Reset only after the service, including the oil and filter change, has been done.
Turn the ignition to ON without starting the engine.
Turn the INFO dial to System Settings and press the dial in.
Choose Service Info and press the dial in.
Choose Reset Service Ind. and press the dial in.
When asked if you are sure, choose Yes.

oil.when: 2008 using the SET and CLR buttons
steps: Reset only after the service, including the oil and filter change, has been done.
Turn the ignition to ON without starting the engine.
Press and hold the SET button until you hear a confirmation tone and the settings menu opens.
Scroll to Time for Service and press SET.
When asked whether to reset, choose YES. Press CLR instead if you want to cancel.
oil.note: The Next Service percentage shown in this menu roughly tracks how much life is left in the engine oil.
